hook: Your friend {friend} just paid ₹2,000 for a job registration fee. The website has disappeared. {friend} is sitting next to you and does not know what to do.
prompt: Help him. Put the steps in the order he should do them.
summary: You know the order now. The first hour matters most.

call_1930.why: First, always. 1930 is the national cybercrime helpline. The sooner they have the details, the better the chance the money can be frozen before it moves on.

bank_block.text: Tell the bank and block the card or account
bank_block.why: Second. The bank can stop anything else leaving the account while the rest is sorted out.

portal.why: Third. This creates the official record. The phone call is fast; the portal makes it formal.

evidence.why: The messages, the website, the payment. Save them before they vanish — fake sites are taken down quickly.

trusted_adult.text: Tell a parent, teacher or trusted adult
trusted_adult.why: Not a step to skip out of embarrassment. Losing money to a scam is not a sign of being foolish — these are designed by people who do this full time.

warn_others.why: The same fake site is being sent to other people right now. One message from you can stop the next one.

concept.recovery: If money is lost to fraud, call 1930 first and report at cybercrime.gov.in. Acting in the first hour gives the best chance of getting it back.

result.fast: You moved fast and got the order right. That gives {friend} the best chance of seeing that money again.
result.good_order: The order was right. Next time, even faster — the first hour matters most.
result.wrong_order: Close. Look at what goes first: the helpline call comes before everything else, because it is what can still stop the money.
result.saved: These steps are now saved on your home screen. They work without internet.

helpcard.title: If money is lost to fraud
helpcard.footer: 1930 is free to call. cybercrime.gov.in is the official portal. It is never too late to report.

hook_ponzi: {friend} just lost {amount, rupees} to Double Dhamaka. The office is empty and the phone numbers are dead. {friend} is sitting next to you and does not know what to do.
